name: Liz Larson
stance: Opposes a federal moratorium on state AI laws.

statements.text: Co-led the letter of more than 260 state legislators asking Congress to drop the 10-year AI moratorium.
Her SB 168, regulating minors’ use of chatbots, was deferred to the 41st legislative day (killed) in committee.

review.note: research pass, September 2026; not yet reviewed
